reading_hypothesis: Store the current character and its same/tail subtree together as one owned Letter, then balance only the less/more sibling tree. The four red-red rotations should share one reconstruction grammar while the lookup and insertion keep their earned less/same/more rhythm.
representation: Trie is a red-black sibling tree; each Letter is either the exact end-of-string binding Here or a character plus its independent next-prefix Trie.
invariants: Every externally retained sibling root is black.
Red sibling nodes have black children.
All root-to-Vacant sibling paths have equal black height.
Sibling labels are strictly ordered with Here before every character, including NUL.
Equal-character descent enters a separate black-root sibling tree.
All owned subtrees occur once after a rotation.
risks: The package laws establish their existing observational boundary, not universal balancing correctness. Additional invariant and adversarial checks are required.
The implementation and complexity documentation change from Base Map and still require coordinator review.
No performance acceptance is claimed before measurements.
fixed_inputs: Every original non-main Bend file remains byte-identical to the frozen independent inputs.
